amendments.text: (a) An applicant shall be issued a type certificate when he demonstrates the eligibility of the airplane by complying with the requirements of this part in addition to the applicable requirements in Part 1 of the Civil Air Regulations. (b) The type certificate shall be deemed to include the type design (see § 3.14 (b)), the operating limitations for the airplane (see § 3.737), and any other conditions or limitations prescribed by the Civil Air Regulations. (See also § 3.11 (a).)
